Question 13
?

Find the equation of the level surface for the function f(x,y,z)=ln⁡(x+2y+3z) that passes through the point P(1,1,0).

a
x+2y+3z+ln⁡3=0
b
x+2y+3z−3=0
c
x2+y2+z2=(ln⁡3)2
d
x2+y2+z2=32
e
x+2y+3z−ln⁡3=0
